chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Ja'far, who said:

I wrote to Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him), 'A woman breast-fed a man's child. Is it permissible for that man to marry the daughter of this breast-feeder or not?' So he (peace be upon him) signed: 'No, she is not permissible to him.'
ai.seo_question: Can a man marry the daughter of the woman who breast-fed him?
ai.summary: This correspondence between Shaykh al-Kulayni and Imam al-Hadi (peace be upon him) clarifies the scope of *radāʿ* (breast-feeding kinship), establishing that the daughter of the wet-nurse becomes a mahram to the man, thereby prohibiting marriage. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that breast-feeding creates a permanent familial bond comparable to blood lineage, extending the prohibition beyond direct nursing relationships to include the nurse's offspring.
